notes: Strip x 2800-5900 of 22-35N (scale ~1.45 px/ft). Coloured subdivision bands lie on the street side of block lines; water-pipe lines drawn inside streets (often across side-street mouths) were not used as street lines. Straight Street and Tafel Street slope slightly (south side drops ~8 px per 100 px eastward). Straight Street: south side is cut by the neat line everywhere; centre taken as north lot fronts + 60 ft (the '60' label, '6 in W. PIPE' and '24 in SEWER' all sit below the solid pipe line, so that line is a pipe, not the south line). Side-street stubs south of Straight (Luna, Ravine south piece, Westview, Fairview, the '..VE.' stub) are cut at y~6650-6800 by the neat line: drawn-area stops, not real ends. Tafel: south side cut too; centre = lot fronts + 50 ft. Giraud: south line not drawn between Enslin and Ravine; centre from the 60 ft width. Marshall: 40 ft north of Riddle (centre ~3565), 50 ft south of Riddle (centre ~3536), ~60 ft at Probasco (3455-3540). Wagner 50 ft Giraud-Tafel, 25 ft Tafel-Straight. Stratford Avenue: 60 ft Probasco-Giraud; south of Giraud it narrows and bends at y~5880-6060 into a ~33 ft strip (4 in W. pipe, 24 in sewer, house numbers 2600-2626 on the east lots) running to Straight at x~5221; no name printed on the strip, taken as Stratford because the lines are continuous. South of Straight a separate stub labelled only '..VE.' sits ~55 px further west (x~5166): recorded as '?', probably Stratford Avenue (it falls where 1904 sheet 258 has Guy Street meeting Fairview). No 'Ferdinand Place' street exists here: 'FERDINAND BASKEN' (owner) and 'FERD...AND' lettered across lots 101/86/102 south of Clifton View are parcel/subdivision lettering. Taylor/Clifton View (x~2680) lies west of this strip and is not picked. Not recorded: 'DED. FOR STREET PURPOSES' strip north of Riddle at x~4300-4400 (as 35L); 'NORTH LINE OF LOT 60' coloured bands at y~4900-5000 (lot line, not a street); Col. J. Riddle's Sub. bands at x~4890-4935 (boundaries, not a street). Drawn-area stops (not ends): Whitfield at the top edge; Dixmyth, Riddle, Probasco, Joselin, Giraud and Straight continue east to Clifton Avenue (x~6000+, outside this strip).
